events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis' debut album 'Definitely Maybe' was originally released on August 29, 1994, marking a pivotal moment for Britpop.

angles.name: Debut Impact
angles.copy: Twenty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your standout track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a defining moment of the 1960s counterculture, took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Which iconic performance defines it for you?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: August 16, 2026, marks 49 years since the world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today, 49 years after his passing. His music, his style, his legend – still unmatched.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: September 2, 2026, marks 56 years since the passing of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost the extraordinary talent of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring its iconic zebra crossing cover, was released on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57 this month. That album cover, those tracks… pure genius. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the brilliant Chrissie Hynde! From 'Brass in Pocket' to her enduring rock presence, a true icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, and celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that undeniable rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' saw its UK release on October 24, 1975, to promote the 'Shaved Fish' compilation. The album of the same name was released in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' hit the UK charts 51 years ago this month. Its message of peace and unity remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the original iPod launched? It changed everything for music lovers. What was on your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His vision and music continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, celebrating his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was originally released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Double Album Classic
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58 this month. A double album packed with incredible diversity and timeless tracks. What's your favourite deep cut?
